title: GEAS 10-03 Mastery Challenge: Licensure Ratings, Seals, Penal Provisions & Reciprocity
description: Comprehensive 25-item decoupled board examination challenge covering Section 16 passing grades, Section 29 seal dimensions, Section 35 penal provisions, and Section 33 reciprocity under R.A. 9292.

questions.promptText: To pass the Electronics Engineer Licensure Examination, what ratings must an examinee obtain under Section 16?
questions.choiceA: A general weighted average of at least 70%, with no rating below 70% in any subject
questions.choiceB: A general weighted average of at least 75%, with no rating below 50% in any subject
questions.choiceC: A general weighted average of at least 60%, with no rating below 50% in any subject
questions.choiceD: A score of at least 80% in Math and at least 60% in other subjects
questions.explanation: Section 16 requires a general weighted average of at least 70%, with no rating below 70% in any subject.

questions.promptText: Under what condition is an examinee given a removal examination in a failed subject instead of failing the entire exam?
questions.choiceA: If the general weighted average is at least 70%, but one or more subjects are below 70%, provided no subject is below 60%
questions.choiceB: If the general weighted average is at least 65% with any score
questions.choiceC: If the examinee has a GPA of 1.0 in college
questions.choiceD: If the examinee is a first-time taker regardless of score
questions.explanation: Section 16 provides that if the average is $\ge 70\%$, but any subject is $< 70\%$, a removal exam is allowed provided no subject is $< 60\%$.

questions.promptText: Within what maximum time period must an examinee take the removal examination for a conditioned subject under Section 16?
questions.choiceA: Within two (2) years from the date of the examination
questions.choiceB: Within six (6) months from the date of the examination
questions.choiceC: Within five (5) years from the date of the examination
questions.choiceD: Within thirty (30) days from the release of results
questions.explanation: Section 16 states that the removal examination must be taken within two (2) years from the date of the examination.

questions.promptText: Under Section 17, within how many days must the Board and Commission release the official results of the licensure examination?
questions.choiceA: Within fifteen (15) days after the last day of the examination
questions.choiceB: Within thirty (30) days after the examination
questions.choiceC: Within seven (7) days after the examination
questions.choiceD: Within sixty (60) days after the examination
questions.explanation: Section 17 states: 'The Board and the Commission shall correct and release the results of the examination within fifteen (15) days after the last day of the examination.'

questions.promptText: What are the outer and inner diameters of the official dry seal of a Professional Electronics Engineer (PECE) under Section 29?
questions.choiceA: 48 mm outer diameter and 32 mm inner diameter
questions.choiceB: 48 mm outer diameter and 28 mm inner diameter
questions.choiceC: 50 mm outer diameter and 35 mm inner diameter
questions.choiceD: 45 mm outer diameter and 30 mm inner diameter
questions.explanation: Section 29 specifies that the PECE seal consists of two concentric circles with the outer measuring 48 mm in diameter and the inner measuring 32 mm in diameter.

questions.promptText: What are the outer and inner diameters of the official seal of the Board of Electronics Engineering (BECE)?
questions.choiceA: 48 mm outer diameter and 28 mm inner diameter
questions.choiceB: 48 mm outer diameter and 32 mm inner diameter
questions.choiceC: 52 mm outer diameter and 30 mm inner diameter
questions.choiceD: 40 mm outer diameter and 20 mm inner diameter
questions.explanation: Section 29 specifies that the Board seal has an outside circle of 48 mm and an inner circle of 28 mm in diameter.

questions.promptText: What words are inscribed on the upper portion of the annular space of the PECE dry seal?
questions.choiceA: PROFESSIONAL ELECTRONICS ENGINEER
questions.choiceB: BOARD OF ELECTRONICS ENGINEERING
questions.choiceC: REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
questions.choiceD: INSTITUTE OF ELECTRONICS ENGINEERS
questions.explanation: Section 29 specifies that the upper portion of the annular space of the PECE seal bears 'PROFESSIONAL ELECTRONICS ENGINEER', and the lower portion bears 'PHILIPPINES'.

questions.promptText: What graphic symbol is placed on the upper portion of the inner circle of the PECE seal?
questions.choiceA: An atom with a nucleus and electrons
questions.choiceB: A transmission tower with microwave dishes
questions.choiceC: A transistor circuit schematic symbol
questions.choiceD: The Philippine national flag and eagle
questions.explanation: Section 29 states that the inner circle features the appearance of an atom with a nucleus and electrons on the upper portion.

questions.promptText: What is the financial fine prescribed in Section 35 (Penal Provision) for any person who violates R.A. 9292?
questions.choiceA: Not less than ₱100,000 nor more than ₱1,000,000
questions.choiceB: Not less than ₱10,000 nor more than ₱50,000
questions.choiceC: Not less than ₱500,000 nor more than ₱5,000,000
questions.choiceD: Not less than ₱1,000 nor more than ₱10,000
questions.explanation: Section 35 sets the fine at not less than ₱100,000 nor more than ₱1,000,000.

questions.promptText: What is the imprisonment period prescribed in Section 35 for violations of R.A. 9292?
questions.choiceA: Not less than six (6) months nor more than six (6) years
questions.choiceB: Not less than one (1) year nor more than twelve (12) years
questions.choiceC: Not less than thirty (30) days nor more than one (1) year
questions.choiceD: Life imprisonment without parole
questions.explanation: Section 35 sets the imprisonment term at not less than six (6) months nor more than six (6) years.

questions.promptText: How long after revocation of a Certificate of Registration and Professional ID may the Board reinstate the license under Section 24?
questions.choiceA: After the expiration of two (2) years from the date of revocation
questions.choiceB: After six (6) months from revocation
questions.choiceC: After five (5) years from revocation
questions.choiceD: Revoked licenses can never be reinstated under any circumstance
questions.explanation: Section 24 states that the Board may reinstate a revoked Certificate of Registration and ID after the expiration of two (2) years.

questions.promptText: Under Section 26, how many Filipino registered professionals must be employed as understudies/counterparts for every foreign professional hired?
questions.choiceA: At least two (2) Filipino professionals
questions.choiceB: At least one (1) Filipino professional
questions.choiceC: At least three (3) Filipino professionals
questions.choiceD: At least five (5) Filipino professionals
questions.explanation: Section 26 mandates that at least two (2) Filipino professionals shall be employed as understudies for every foreign professional hired.

questions.promptText: What is the maximum initial validity period of a Special Temporary Permit issued to a foreign electronics professional under Section 26?
questions.choiceA: Six (6) months, renewable every 6 months
questions.choiceB: One (1) year, non-renewable
questions.choiceC: Three (3) years automatically
questions.choiceD: Thirty (30) days only
questions.explanation: Section 26 specifies that the Special Temporary Permit is valid for six (6) months and can be renewed every 6 months.

questions.promptText: Can a foreign electronics professional holding a Special Permit engage in independent private practice in the Philippines under Section 26?
questions.choiceA: No, foreign professionals are strictly prohibited from engaging in private practice
questions.choiceB: Yes, provided they pay income tax to the Bureau of Internal Revenue
questions.choiceC: Yes, provided they partner with a local law firm
questions.choiceD: Yes, if they have resided in the Philippines for 3 months
questions.explanation: Section 26 expressly states that the foreigner shall not engage in private practice on their own account.

questions.promptText: What is the legal principle in Section 33 requiring foreign countries to allow Filipino engineers to practice before their citizens can practice in the Philippines?
questions.choiceA: Foreign Reciprocity
questions.choiceB: Extradition Doctrine
questions.choiceC: Diplomatic Immunity
questions.choiceD: Territorial Sovereignty
questions.explanation: Section 33 is titled 'Foreign Reciprocity'.

questions.promptText: Which organization is recognized by law as the sole Integrated and Accredited Professional Organization (APO) for electronics engineers under Section 32?
questions.choiceA: Institute of Electronics Engineers of the Philippines (IECEP)
questions.choiceB: Philippine Institute of Civil Engineers (PICE)
questions.choiceC: Institute of Integrated Electrical Engineers (IIEE)
questions.choiceD: Philippine Society of Mechanical Engineers (PSME)
questions.explanation: Section 32 recognizes IECEP as the sole integrated and accredited professional organization (APO) for PECEs, ECEs, and ECTs.

questions.promptText: Under Section 31, what programs are established for maintaining and upgrading professional competence?
questions.choiceA: Continuing Professional Education (CPE) / Continuing Professional Development (CPD)
questions.choiceB: Mandatory Military Conscription
questions.choiceC: Annual Re-examination in Calculus
questions.choiceD: Community Tree Planting Projects
questions.explanation: Section 31 governs Continuing Professional Education (CPE) and/or Development Programs.

questions.promptText: What happens if a registered PECE uses their official dry seal after their Certificate of Registration has been suspended or revoked?
questions.choiceA: They are criminally liable under Section 35 with fines of ₱100k–₱1M and/or imprisonment of 6 months–6 years
questions.choiceB: They only receive a verbal warning from IECEP
questions.choiceC: They are charged a administrative late fee of ₱50
questions.choiceD: Their seal is confiscated with no further penalties
questions.explanation: Section 35 explicitly lists using an official seal with a revoked/suspended license as a penal offense subject to ₱100K–₱1M fine and/or 6 mos–6 yrs imprisonment.

questions.promptText: What color fill is specified for the inner circle background in the official Seal of the Board of ECE under Section 29?
questions.choiceA: Navy blue background with a white atom and red nucleus/electrons
questions.choiceB: Pure bright yellow background with black text
questions.choiceC: Solid emerald green background with gold stars
questions.choiceD: Plain white background with grey shading
questions.explanation: Section 29 specifies that the Board seal inner circle is filled with navy blue background, atom with white, and nucleus and electrons in red.

questions.promptText: What colors are specified for the outer and inner rings of the official Seal of the Board of ECE?
questions.choiceA: Filled with orange with boundaries in navy blue
questions.choiceB: Filled with silver with boundaries in red
questions.choiceC: Filled with purple with boundaries in green
questions.choiceD: Filled with gold with boundaries in black
questions.explanation: Section 29 specifies that the outer and inner rings of the Board seal are filled with orange with boundaries in navy blue.

questions.promptText: Under Section 34, what types of positions in government agencies require the services of registered and licensed PECEs, ECEs, and ECTs?
questions.choiceA: All positions whose duties involve the practice of electronics engineering or technical supervision of electronics systems
questions.choiceB: Only cabinet-level department secretaries
questions.choiceC: Only elected municipal mayors and councilors
questions.choiceD: Only Supreme Court associate justices
questions.explanation: Section 34 states that all government positions with functions falling within the scope of practice of PECE, ECE, or ECT must be filled by licensed professionals.

questions.promptText: Under Section 36, which government agencies are mandated to assist the Board and Commission in enforcing R.A. 9292?
questions.choiceA: Law enforcement agencies, including the PNP, NBI, and public prosecutors
questions.choiceB: The Department of Agriculture and Bureau of Fisheries
questions.choiceC: The National Museum and Cultural Center
questions.choiceD: The Philippine Postal Corporation only
questions.explanation: Section 36 requires law enforcement agencies of the national, provincial, and city governments to assist in enforcing the Act.

questions.promptText: If an examinee achieves scores of: Math = 70%, GEAS = 70%, Electronics = 70%, EST = 69%, with a GWA of 69.75%, what is their result?
questions.choiceA: Failed (GWA is below 70%, so the examinee must retake all subjects)
questions.choiceB: Passed with honors
questions.choiceC: Removal exam in EST only
questions.choiceD: Exempted from taking GEAS
questions.explanation: Because the GWA (69.75%) is below 70%, the examinee fails the examination and cannot qualify for a removal exam.

questions.promptText: Which document serves as conclusive evidence that a person is legally authorized to practice electronics engineering in the Philippines?
questions.choiceA: Valid Certificate of Registration and Professional Identification Card issued by the Board and PRC
questions.choiceB: College diploma from an engineering school only
questions.choiceC: Transcript of records showing high math grades
questions.choiceD: Receipt of payment for review center tuition
questions.explanation: Section 19 states that a Certificate of Registration and Professional Identification Card issued by the Board and PRC is conclusive evidence of authority to practice.

questions.promptText: Under Section 39, who has the primary authority to prepare and issue the Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR) of R.A. 9292?
questions.choiceA: The Board of Electronics Engineering, subject to the approval of the Professional Regulation Commission
questions.choiceB: The Department of Transportation only
questions.choiceC: The Supreme Court of the Philippines
questions.choiceD: The Senate Committee on Education
questions.explanation: Section 39 states that the Board, subject to the approval of the Commission, shall promulgate the Implementing Rules and Regulations.
